mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic weakness that depresses corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% occurs in 10 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1500) and retail sales (RSAFS < 550000) indicate broad-based demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 550000 occur in 10 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, industrial production decline below 100 signals supply constraints that trigger inflation fears and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, INDPRO < 100 occurs but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% reflects strong labor market conditions that support corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% persists for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1500 thousand units indicate weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1500 occurs in 10 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signal transitory inflation where the Fed delays rate hikes, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% occur in 10 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, real GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals improving economic conditions that drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recoveries, GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized occurs but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.
